briefdescription.para: Distribute mass according to a distribution.

Mass is distributed in parallel from two copies of the source mass.

briefdescription.para: Compute the loop scale for a loop.
Adjust the mass of all headers in an irreducible loop.

detaileddescription.para: Initially, irreducible loops are assumed to distribute their mass equally among its headers. This can lead to wrong frequency estimates since some headers may be executed more frequently than others.
This adjusts header mass distribution so it matches the weights of the backedges going into each of the loop headers.
Calculates final frequencies and cleans up no-longer-needed data structures.
